name: codex-monitor
description: Wake an existing Codex Remote Control session on timers or background events.

interface.shortDescription: Wake your existing remote session on timers and events.
interface.longDescription: The remote session starts a background monitor through its own shell; events return to the same App Server and thread. Existing App control and approvals are preserved.
defaultPrompt: Use $monitor to check this task in ten minutes.
Use $monitor to watch training until it completes.
Use $monitor to list or cancel my background watches.
